orgDesign.companyProfile: Digital mental wellbeing platform centered on member support, employer-sponsored access, contributor supply, and privacy-sensitive trust operations.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Member-facing teams own support discovery, community, and habit loops. Employer teams own onboarding, account health, and reporting. Contributor teams own supply, publishing, and event delivery. Shared trust and intelligence teams own privacy, moderation, identity, and data products.
designPrinciples: Keep support discovery, community participation, and habit loops tightly connected because member trust compounds through repeated use.
Separate employer operations from member experience so privacy and confidentiality remain explicit by design.
Treat contributor operations and trust as product capabilities rather than back-office support because the product depends on daily quality supply.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Use top-level groups for member growth, employer solutions, contributor network, and trust and intelligence.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
